SANDEEP AEGULA
(cid:131) +91 7416156814 | # aegulasandeep@gmail.com | (cid:239) linkedin.com/in/sandeep-aegula | § github.com/sandeep-aegula
Professional Summary
Computer Science (AI/ML) undergraduate with practical experience in Agentic AI, Machine Learning, full-stack web
development, and cloud platforms. Proven track record of building and deploying scalable AI-powered applications and
data-driven solutions. AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and Unity Certified Associate with industry exposure at Intel.
Dedicated to technical mastery in Agentic AI and Full Stack web development looking to contribute to high-impact
engineering teams.
Education
Marri Laxman Reddy Institute of Technology and Management Hyderabad, India
B.Tech in Computer Science – Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning 2023 - Present
• CGPA: 8.96 / 10.0
Technical Skills
Languages: Python, Java, JavaScript (ES6+), SQL, C#
AI/ML: Machine Learning, Agentic AI, RAG, LLMs, Vector Databases, Data Analysis
Web Development: React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, Socket.io
Cloud/DevOps: AWS (EC2, S3, CloudWatch), Docker, Git
Databases: MongoDB, MySQL
Tools: Unity, Postman, VS Code , n8n
Certifications: AWS Cloud Practitioner | Unity Associate Game Developer | IBM AI Foundations
Work Experience
Industrial Trainee – AI & Network Security May 2025 – July 2025
Intel Technology India Private Limited Remote
• Built ML-based network traffic analysis system on 50K+ samples, improving detection accuracy by 15% and
reducing processing latency by 20%.
• Implemented input validation and sanitization layer, eliminating SQL injection vulnerabilities and improving
system security compliance.
• Developed phishing detection and malicious URL classification module, achieving 92% classification accuracy on
test data.
Projects
PRISM – Conversational Data Intelligence Next.js, FastAPI, Groq, Gemini API, Python Jan 2026
• Built a full-stack dashboard using FastAPI and Groq to convert natural language into data scripts.
• Created an AI interface for non-technical users to perform complex statistical analysis without code.
• Reduced data exploration time by 90% through automated visualization and real-time CSV processing.(link)
Google Arcade Points Calculator React.js, Node.js, Puppeteer, MongoDB Oct 2025
• Engineered a Puppeteer scraper to automate real-time progress extraction from Google Cloud profiles.
• Developed a MongoDB-backed system to synchronize badge counts, replacing tedious manual tracking.
• Scaled to support 1,000+ global users with instant progress updates during high-traffic seasons.(link)
Achievements & Leadership
Hackathon Winner – Cloud Quest Hyderabad, India
AWS Cloud Challenge 2024
• Engineered high-availability cloud infrastructure using AWS EC2 and S3 with real-time auto-scaling and
monitoring via CloudWatch, winning second place among competing teams.
Technical Speaker & Workshop Lead MLRITM ,Dundigal
Unity Game Development & VR Workshop – 50+ Students Trained 2025
• Conducted hands-on workshops on Unity Game Development and Virtual Reality (VR) for 50+ students, covering
C# scripting, immersive technology design, and practical application development.
